messages:
nina: Heads up 7 Acme Cloud just flipped a change that strips `po_number` from marketplace webhook payloads. Our ingestion dropped ~12 POs.
omar: Prod? when did this start?
nina: Started around 09:03 UTC. Partner PM says it's a cleanup for internal ids.
liz: Finance: we need the canonical `po_number` to match invoices. Without it, payments could be delayed.
acme-eng: (from Acme) We're aware, rolling back in 2h. Sending corrected webhooks is on our runbook. Ticket ACME-10512.
finance-bot: Alert: 12 unmatched POs detected. Report export queued.
omar: Can we re-ingest using `partner_ref` as a stopgap? Risk: duplicates for partners that reuse refs.
nina: I'd prefer not to auto-map without signoff. Proposal: 1) ingest using `partner_ref` into a holding table; 2) mark records `needs_manual_review=true`; 3) notify Finance with CSV.
liz: That works. Finance will review CSV and approve mapping for each row. I can spare two people for this for the day.
acme-eng: We'll re-emit corrected webhooks once rollback completes. ETA 2h. We'll also push a patch to validate `po_number` presence.
omar: Okay, implement holding table + CSV flow. Add a ledger flag so downstream accounting ignores holding rows.
nina: I'll open a PR for the shim and the CSV exporter now. ETA ~90m to ship.
liz: Please include `original_payload` in the CSV for audit and include a column `acme_ticket` pointing to ACME-10512.
finance-bot: CSV ready: s3://redwood-internal/exports/acme_po_holding_1821112223.csv
nina: Thanks. I'll update partners channel and loop procurement/legal if Acme doesn't confirm resends within 4 hours.
acme-eng: Confirmed we will re-send. Apologies for the disruption.
omar: If they don't re-send, procurement will consider holding new Acme orders. Keep me posted.
liz: I'll start manual reconciliation when CSV arrives. Thanks everyone.
